'''2020 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on [[GEMP]]. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Paul Myers]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens/. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022095952/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens.html Internet Archive]</ref> The 2020 Online Championship Series, the third year of the series, ran for nine and a half months (February–November 2020) with almost 2,500 games; its finals ended on 10 November 2020.<ref name="dc-775804305680367636">"After 9.5 months & almost 2500 games, this year's Online Championship Series", JaredNap in #ocs-discussion, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (10 November 2020). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749413518431748107/775804305680367636 Discord message]</ref><ref name="slack-ocs20-play">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 9 October – 10 November 2020: “OCS Match of stubbly vs retwin316” (7 October 2020, replay 9 October); “1) Shaw wins G1 +10 v. Steviegets ... 2) & 3) ototoi advances v. arebelspy. 4) zlorfik wins G1 +18 v. Silverglen ... Also allstarz97 plays tge_damen G1 @ 2:00pm EDT Sunday.” (11 October 2020); “Shaw advanced past Steviegets this morning.” (11 October 2020); “Quarterfinal action! ... 4 seed stubbly squares off with 5 seed CoffeePass.” (16 October 2020); “Echobstrpr takes on defending champion zlorfik” (20 October 2020); “G1 of the allstarz97 v. shaw67193 match ... G2 of echobstrpr v. zlorfik (+8)” (21 October 2020); “final quarterfinal matchup between pmyers & ototoi” (1 November 2020); “Bastian Winkelhaus squares off w/ ... Justin Desai in G1 of their 2020 OCS Semifinal match” (3 November 2020); “1 seed pmyers will play game 1 of his match with 4 seed stubbly.” (6 November 2020); “Myers will be Light Side & won the 1st game by 14.” (7 November 2020); “Game 2 of Desai-Winkelhaus” (8 November 2020); “Final Confrontation ... 1 seed pmyers faces 2 seed allstarz97” (9 November 2020); “The 2020 OCS Finals have concluded! After 9.5 months & almost 2500 games, this year's Online Championship Series has crowned a winner: Justin Desai! Congratulations to him & runner-up Paul Myers.” (10 November 2020).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Qualifiers:''' February–August 2020 (seven monthly qualifiers of two spots each plus two seasonal at-large bids)<ref name="slack-ocs20-qual">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 April – 31 August 2020: “The March OCS has come to an end, w/ allstarz97 & ototoi (both 11-1) grabbing the 2 qualifier spots” (1 April 2020); “The May OCS Qualifier is in the books, with shaw61793 and zlorfik taking the two spots for the month.” (1 June 2020); “Congratulations to June OCS qualifiers, Steviegets (12-0) & Silverglen (11-1).” (1 July 2020); “The July OCS Qualifier is virtually in the books. Bkippel (10-2) & aeneas23 (10-2) take the 2 spots for July.” (31 July 2020); “Congrats to CoffeePass (11-1) & pmyers (11-10) for taking the 2 qualifier spots for the August OCS!” (31 August 2020); “Also congrats to echobstrpr (61-23, 206 pts) & stubbly (60-24, 204 pts) for clinching the 2 seasonal at-large bids!” (31 August 2020).</ref>
* '''Playoffs:''' October–10 November 2020<ref name="slack-ocs20-play" />
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ forum]

== Qualifiers ==

Published monthly qualifier spots and seasonal at-large bids from the seven-month regular season:<ref name="slack-ocs20-qual" />
* '''March:''' [[Justin Desai]] (11–1), [[Eric Hunter]] (11–1)
* '''May:''' [[Greg Shaw]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''June:''' [[Steve Baroni]] (12–0), [[Justin Branch]] (11–1)
* '''July:''' [[Brad Kippel]] (10–2), [[Nick Reisch]] (10–2)
* '''August:''' [[Drew Lichtenstein]] (11–1), [[Paul Myers]]
* '''Seasonal at-large:''' [[Adam Fletcher]] (61–23, 206 pts), [[Conor Britain]] (60–24, 204 pts)

== Top 16 seeds ==

The 16-player playoff bracket announced on 31 August 2020:<ref name="slack-ocs20-seeds">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 31 August 2020: “2020 OCS-Top 16 (1-8): 1 pmyers (GA) (Dagobah) 2 allstarz97 (MA) (Kashyyyk) 3 echobstrpr (UT) (Tatooine) 4 stubbly (CA) (Alderaan) 5 CoffeePass (GA) (Dagobah) 6 jnapolit31 (PA) (Coruscant) 7 zlorfik (Ralltiir) 8 Bkippel (GA) (Dagobah)”; “2020 OCS-Top16 (9-16): 9 retwin316 (IN) (Nal Hutta) 10 Steviegets (MA) (Kashyyyk) 11 aeneas23 (TX) (Dantooine) 12 shaw61793 (NJ) (Coruscant) 13 arebelspy (WA) (Endor) 14 Silverglen (Naboo) 15 tge_damen (Ryloth) 16 ototoi (MA) (Kashyyyk)”.</ref>
